claim: In games that reach round 500 on layouts where the queen can leave spawn, a lone queen of ours (their queen died in an earlier round) is alive at the end less than 0.7 times as often as a lone queen of theirs, on main and on v31; and per turn spent as the only queen, with all games counted, ours dies faster than theirs.
how_to_count: Games: our_code main or v31 counted apart; map_key with queen_spawn_dead_end false; for the first part only games whose last raw round is 499. Queens are dragons 0 and 1; each side has one. Lone queen of a side = the other side queen died in a strictly earlier raw round (or died while this one never died). Survival = that lone queen is alive in the final state. Report survivors / lone queens for each side; then the same for main opponents rated 1700-1899 and 1900-2099, for layouts with width times height above 1200 and the rest (both codes pooled), and for main games before and from 2026-10-06T14:48:15Z. Second part, all games on those layouts including eliminations: for every turn start of a queen at which the other queen is already dead, count one lone turn for her side; deaths = lone queens that died; report deaths per 1,000 lone turns per side and code (my turn counts come from games up to battle 1276407 only, 665 games; a recount over all 705 main and v31 games is better). Please also judge: whether restricting to full games biases the first part (our 76 elimination wins and their 36 are left out), whether one or two opponents or layouts carry their surviving lone queens, and whether the gap is still there when only games level in total length at r100 (within 20 percent) are used.

claim: Between raw rounds 101 and 200 our queen dies by wall or own body many times as often as their queens do, on main and on v31, while in the other windows the two sides are level; Maze carries nearly half of it.
how_to_count: Games: our_code main or v31 counted apart; map_key with queen_spawn_dead_end false; the game reached raw round 200. For each side, queens alive after raw round 100; count those whose dragonDeath is in raw rounds 101 to 200 with engine reason 0 (wall) or 1 (own body). Report deaths / queens alive at r100 per side and code, and per layout. Second table, games with last raw round 499 only: queen deaths by wall or own body per side in raw rounds 0-100, 101-200, 201-300, 301-499, and beside it deaths as the standing victim of an enemy head-on in the same windows. Please also count what I have not: for each of our 51 such deaths in r101-200 (21 main, 30 v31) and their 12, at the start of her last turn, what is on each of the four tiles next to her head (kelp edge in between, her own body, a body of her own team, an enemy body, free), how many legal steps she had, and whether she made a split in the 10 rounds before; and judge whether Maze, Portals and weakhold are all of it.
